title: Chapter 432: Battle Against Norn
content:
Chapter 432: Battle Against Norn

When Wang Shuo heard this, his heart tightened. Although he knew that the three-star secret realm token was not that easy to obtain, Wang Shuo was still a little uneasy when he had to fight against a veteran star-level boss.

But Wang Shuo was not afraid, and was even eager to try.

"good."

Wang Shuo knew that if he won this battle, it would be peace, but if he didn't win, he might end up here.

He can be resurrected, but his two subordinates will have to answer here.

Moreover, the demon clan will even directly annex the Dahuai Territory.

Wang Shuo once again upgraded his aura to the level of a senior warrior.

In this battle, we must show our strength as much as possible and intimidate our opponents.

Although it is basically not a deterrent to the Demon King.

Norn's transformed human form looked gentle, but the weapons he took out were actually two copper hammers.

It seems to be taking the power route.

Wang Shuo didn't hesitate and immediately took out the Shura Demon-Breaking Spear.

As soon as the gun came out, the Demon King's eyes changed leisurely.

"Shura?"

He murmured in a low voice, his eyes filled with murderous intent.

But after a few thoughts, the murderous look in his eyes dissipated.

Wang Shuo naturally didn't notice the Demon King's expression. He was now looking at Noen with all his concentration.

The two of them started a duel in the main hall.

Wang Shuo did not use control skills from the beginning, but planned to wait until the critical moment to have a surprising effect.

The spear danced, and the spear came out like a dragon.

Wang Shuo's marksmanship became more and more proficient, and dragon-shaped shadows kept attacking Norn.

As the battle progressed, Wang Shuo also accumulated enough anger and activated the red pupil state.

In this way, Wang Shuo has the ability to fight for a long time.

Norn did not retain his strength, but just started the competition. There was no reason to go all out. The previous moves seemed a bit gentle.

Noen immediately shouted loudly, and the muscles on his limbs swelled rapidly.

Obviously, he used some kind of secret method and his strength was greatly improved.

Not to be outdone, Wang Shuo activated the "Doubling Technique".

The battle between the two became more intense.

If Wang Shuo wants to maximize the power of Shura Slash, he must continue to accumulate anger. When Norn attacks, he will defend and take time to use a few ultimate moves.

If Norn is on the defensive, he will seize the opportunity and attack with a few attacks.

At the same time, Wang Shuo's attack speed became faster and faster. Under the influence of the repeated speed, Noen finally became a little anxious.

I saw him shouting loudly again, and the giant hammer suddenly slammed down.

Wang Shuo raised his gun with both hands to block, and the huge force directly bent Wang Shuo's legs.

At this time, Wang Shuo still had two important skills that he had not used. One was a passive skill that could withstand a fatal blow.

There is also "absolute defense", which is equivalent to invincibility.

Wang Shuo did not intend to expose these two skills.

So he activated "Iron Rope Binding", then quickly got rid of Norn, took two steps back, and then launched "Shura Slash".

The reason why the Demon King was patient was because he wanted to see what tricks Shura had.

Seeing Wang Shuo's "Asura Slash", the Demon Emperor was finally moved.

Seeing a devastating blow coming from high altitude, Norn's pupils suddenly widened and he raised his giant hammer to resist.

But his giant hammer was soon shattered.

As a last resort, he turned into a body to resist.

But he didn't expect that his body was actually a big turtle.

The huge attack pressed his limbs deeply into the ground.

But he still resisted. After all, the opponent was a star-level boss, and he was also a turtle who was good at defense.

Wang Shuo then figured out why his attack was not sharp enough. It turned out that he was good at defense.

"That's enough."

Demon King Naris scolded, being able to force Norn to such an extent, Wang Shuo's strength has been recognized by the Demon King.
